_about: Tiling surface textures for walls, buildings and the ground: web/assets/textures/<id>.jpg.
Built from downloaded packs (outside the repo, in ../asset_drop or $ASSET_DROP) by
node tools/art/assets.mjs textures     (needs Blender; repaints larger and seamless).
crop (optional): [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the source image.
generator (instead of source): painted from scratch by tools/art/build_textures.py.
Which prop uses which texture, and how many metres one tile covers, is set in the palette: greybox.surfaces.
SHARED: talk to the team lead before changing an existing entry.
